integrity: Proof uses elementary series and the established canonical-sequence characterization from Bouzar (2008). A finite exact-rational checker is supplementary rather than a proof of infinite claims.
scientific_limitations: Zero-based independent geometric variables with parameters strictly between 0 and 1. The self-decomposability notion is binomial thinning, not ordinary multiplication. Symmetric-case log-concavity is a known consequence of stronger geometric-range results; novelty emphasis is the explicit folded-Laplace compound-Poisson decomposition and sharp thinning-self-decomposability phase region. No assertion of comprehensive global novelty or independent validation.
title: Sharp thinning self-decomposability phase diagram for folded skew discrete Laplace laws
